events.title: Home-network planning context
events.summary: WebTV planned a gateway within HomeNet, with nodes and input peripherals as separate devices. This planning record precedes the development chassis. Credit: WebTV planning.

events.title: Plan the opening mechanical reviews
events.summary: Roy asked Erik to begin Galaxy component-concept discussions. A week later, Erik proposed reviewing case-closure concepts while Roy said he would bring more specific thermal constraints. These messages establish planned reviews, not proof that the meetings occurred. Credit: Roy Askeland; Erik.

events.title: Thermal model
events.summary: The 150 W, 45°C-ambient simulation linked component placement to airflow and called attention to the smart-card location. Its results are analytical, not prototype measurements. Credit: Avijit.

events.title: Separate drive support from air partition
events.summary: The mechanical review kept a separate air partition after rejecting the drive bracket as the combined support and partition. Smart-card placement also remained a packaging decision. Credit: WebTV mechanical review; Erik mechanical follow-up.

events.title: Review a manufacturable CPU shield
events.summary: NT Vision proposed stiffness features, folded sides and staged blanking for the perforated shield. These were supplier recommendations while internal requirements and gauges remained open. Credit: Pauline Soh / NT Vision; Frank Salinas review.
events.date_basis: Exact reader date label; source-specific date precision, state and actors retained in the registered research chronology.

events.title: Challenge the chassis forming plan
events.summary: D&D warned that the drawn standoff layout could warp the base and proposed alternate forms or ribs. Frank also identified the openings those alternatives could expose. Credit: Chuck Pokonosky / D&D; Frank Salinas.
events.date_basis: Exact reader date label; source-specific date precision, state and actors retained in the registered research chronology.
